title: Racing and motorsport heritage — Lincoln Continental (1961-1969)
description: Racing and motorsport heritage of the Lincoln Continental (1961-1969): Competition history and homologation specials. The 1961 Lincoln Continental, with its clean slab sides and rear-hinged 'suicide' doors, is a design landmark — the car Kennedy was riding in Dallas. The four-door convertible is the most collectible. With 430 and 462 V8s, it was America's most elegant sedan of the 1960s. Baseline facts: American luxury sedan 1961-1969; suicide doors; design landmark of the 1960s..
